name: Nivedita Roy

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Nivedita Roy is a teacher and bilingual writer from Lucknow, based in Bahrain. Her books include the English poetry collection Gallery De’ Heart, the Hindi collection Komal Ehsas and the environmental poems of Earthly Echoes. Alongside her own writing, she hosts poetry readings and conversations about books.

Her Kabita Live poem ‘Mourning Manipur’ approaches collective suffering through a valley whose apparent calm gives way to devastation. Damaged trees, flowers and changing seasons connect the landscape with a woman’s experience of violence and blame. The poem’s movement between the individual and the valley gives public grief an intimate form.
